lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately vertical columns. Posterior to the gill slits, these nodes form a repeating pattern of three to four spots per column, spaced at regular vertical intervals.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a visible grid-like structure across the mid-section of the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear feature characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient runs horizontally along the upper third of the flank, showing high luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.
